Four arrested for separate robberies in Gurugram and Noida

Police in Gurugram have arrested four individuals, including a juvenile, in connection with a robbery. Separately, in Noida, four people were apprehended for robbing a man after forcing him into a car. These incidents highlight ongoing law and order concerns in the National Capital Region.
